location.provenance: THE PEOPLE OF THE STATE OF NEVADA, REPRESENTED IN SENATE AND ASSEMBLY, DO ENACT AS FOLLOWS:

status.provenance: AN ACT relating to toxic chemicals; prohibiting, with certain exceptions, the discharge, use or release of certain Class B firefighting foams;

date.provenance: Sections 6 to 14.5, inclusive, of this act become effective: ... (b) On January 1, 2022, for all other purposes.

pfas_definition.provenance: 'Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals that contain at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: prohibiting, with certain exceptions, the discharge, use or release of certain Class B firefighting foams;

date.provenance: Sections 6 to 14.5, inclusive, of this act become effective: ... (b) On January 1, 2022, for all other purposes.

who.provenance: a person, political subdivision, local government or state or local agency shall not discharge, use or release, or allow its employees or independent contractors to discharge, use or release, any Class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

action.provenance: shall not discharge, use or release, or allow its employees or independent contractors to discharge, use or release

value: Class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

exceptions.provenance: unless the person testing the foam has ensured that any measures necessary for the proper containment, treatment and disposal of the foam are available at the testing location; The provisions of sections 12 and 13 of this act do not apply to the extent that those provisions are preempted by or conflict with federal law

intentionally_added.provenance: Class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

type.provenance: prohibiting, with certain exceptions, the manufacture, sale or distribution of certain products containing certain chemicals

date.provenance: Sections 1 to 5, inclusive, and 15 to 26, inclusive, of this act become effective: ... (b) On July 1, 2022, for all other purposes.

who.provenance: a manufacturer or wholesaler shall not knowingly manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale or distribute for use in this State a children's product, upholstered residential furniture, residential textile, business textile or mattress that contains any flame-retardant organohalogenated chemical

action.provenance: shall not knowingly manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale or distribute for use

value: thread or fiber for stitching mattress components together
components of an adult mattress other than foam
exceptions.provenance: The provisions of this section do not apply to: ... (a) The extent preempted by federal law; (b) Any flame-retardant organohalogenated chemical that: (1) Is a polymeric substance; ... (c) The sale or offer for sale of any previously owned product; (d) An electronic component; (e) A children's product, mattress, upholstered residential furniture or residential textile for which there is a federal or national flammability standard; (f) Thread or fiber for stitching mattress components together; or (g) Components of an adult mattress other than foam.
